Convert a precision matrix to partial correlations

Source: R/pcor.R
precision_to_pcor.Rd

Computes \(\rho_{ij} = -\Omega_{ij} / \sqrt{\Omega_{ii}\Omega_{jj}}\), with unit diagonal.

Usage

precision_to_pcor(Omega)

Arguments

Omega

A square precision (inverse covariance) matrix.

Value

A symmetric matrix of partial correlations with the dimnames of Omega. If any diagonal entry of Omega is not finite and positive, a matrix of NA is returned with a warning.

Examples

Omega <- matrix(c(2, -0.8, 0, -0.8, 2, -0.5, 0, -0.5, 1.5), 3, 3)
precision_to_pcor(Omega)
#>      [,1]      [,2]      [,3]
#> [1,]  1.0 0.4000000 0.0000000
#> [2,]  0.4 1.0000000 0.2886751
#> [3,]  0.0 0.2886751 1.0000000
